cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallChiselHolder
cc:Work.dc:description:
Wall tool holder for chisels, files and similar tools
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallChiselHolder --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --number 7 --hooks everythird --walltype 'french cleat' --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallChiselHolder --number --hooks --walltype --reference --labels
